blocks.text: The proposed workflow captures both outputs, reuses the evaluation rubric, and prepares one report. The potential gain is less time assembling evidence, with the same review checks kept in place.

pages.title: Roadmap
pages.summary: Each phase has a concrete deliverable and a reason to continue.

items.label: Measure the baseline
items.detail: Record time spent collecting inputs, comparing results and preparing the report.

items.label: Pilot one workflow
items.detail: Use the same input set and ask reviewers to check both versions.

items.label: Evaluate the result
items.detail: Compare measured time and review quality. Expand only if both are acceptable.

items.title: A shorter review can miss important context
items.mitigation: Retain source excerpts, record reviewer disagreements, and check output completeness.
